battle.name: 第七次反法同盟
battle.theater: 滑鐵盧與沙勒羅瓦戰場
battle.brief: 一八一五年六月，拿破崙自厄爾巴返法重啟戰端，維也納列強集結第七次同盟，決戰於比利時滑鐵盧。西班牙輪發手槍自十六世紀起即為火槍隊軍官與近衛的標準佩槍，到一八一五年已讓位於燧發手槍，只餘王宮武庫的儀仗舊例，其簧輪擊發的傳統則延續在西班牙軍官佩帶的燧發手槍上。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 法蘭西帝國一方以拿破崙自任的北方集團軍為骨幹：一八一五年三月集結於法比邊境，總兵力約十二萬五千人，可戰之兵約八萬，下分埃斯特瓦爾、內伊、格魯希、格拉沃、莫爾捷與德埃隆六個軍，另有朱爾、傑羅姆與穆拉特的輔助兵團。帝國的附屬與盟邦包括威斯特法利亞王國、義大利王國、那不勒斯王國、華沙公國的波蘭軍團，以及萊茵同盟各邦的輔助部隊。第七次同盟一方以英、俄、普、奧四國條約為核心，外加瑞典、葡萄牙、西班牙三國與一批德意志邦國；漢諾威、不倫瑞克、拿騷、黑森-卡塞爾、梅克倫堡、奧爾登堡等邦國並非以國家身分作戰，而是以部隊名義編入聯軍序列。聯軍的指揮體系分兩層：威靈頓公爵統率英荷聯軍第一集團軍，轄英軍師、荷屬比利時師團與德意志外籍旅；普軍由布盧歇爾元帥統率，格奈森瑙任參謀長，下轄克賴斯特第一軍、皮爾希第二軍、蒂爾曼第三軍、畢洛第四軍與齊滕的第五軍騎兵；奧軍由施瓦岑貝格元帥統率波希米亞兵團，俄軍由巴克萊·德·托利率領，瑞典王儲貝納多特指揮北方聯軍。指揮權的頂點是維也納四國同盟會議及其從屬的同盟國代表會議，聯軍在布魯塞爾另設由奧蘭治親王與諾斯伯爵組成的臨時政府。西班牙軍隊沒有投入滑鐵盧主戰場，而是由埃斯波茲·米納將軍在法國北部作戰、安古萊姆公爵率領法西聯軍進軍法國南部，埃布萊則以加泰隆尼亞法軍旅的身分隨西班牙國籍作戰，牽制法軍相當兵力。
countriesEn: The French side was built around the Army of the North, commanded by Napoleon in person: some 125,000 men concentrated along the Franco-Belgian frontier in March 1815, of whom roughly eighty thousand were fit for service, distributed among the corps of Esteve, Ney, Grouchy, Gravois, Mortier and d'Erlon, together with the auxiliary brigades of Junot, Jerome and Murat. The Empire's satellites and allies were the Kingdom of Westphalia, the Kingdom of Italy, the Kingdom of Naples under Murat, the Polish corps of the Duchy of Warsaw, and contingents supplied by the states of the Rhine Confederation. The Seventh Coalition rested on the Quadruple Alliance of Britain, Russia, Prussia and Austria, joined by Sweden, Portugal and Spain and by a cluster of German states; Hanover, Brunswick, Nassau, Hesse-Kassel, Mecklenburg and Oldenburg did not fight as sovereign armies but entered the war in contingents attached to the allied order of battle. Allied command was organised in two tiers. The Duke of Wellington led the Anglo-Allied army, mixing British divisions with the Dutch-Belgian corps and the German foreign legions; Blücher led the Prussian army with Gneisenau as his chief of staff, with Kleist, Pirch, Thielmann and Bülow commanding the first four corps and Zieten commanding the fifth, a cavalry corps; Schwarzenberg commanded the Austrian army of Bohemia, Barclay de Tolly the Russians, and the Crown Prince of Sweden the northern allied force. Above them stood the congress of the four powers at Vienna and the congress of allied envoys, while a provisional government of the Prince of Orange and the Earl of Aberdeen administered the liberated Belgian provinces from Brussels. Spanish troops never fought on the Waterloo field itself: Espoz y Mina operated in northern France, the Duke of Angoulême led French and Spanish columns into the south of France, and Éblé, commanding the French Catalonia brigade in Spanish service, drew troops away from Napoleon's front.
people: 拿破崙·波拿巴是全戰役的核心：他以皇帝身分兼北方集團軍總司令，十八日在拉貝利昂的炮火中身中霰彈，左腿受傷，仍在馬上接見近衛軍，詢問那聲音是潰退還是衝鋒。威靈頓公爵以五十二歲之齡指揮山脊上的英荷聯軍，頂住德埃隆的正面攻擊與內伊上萬騎兵的連續衝鋒。普軍總帥布盧歇爾已年過七旬，駐軍瓦弗雷，聽聞滑鐵盧的炮聲即令畢洛第四軍冒雨行軍馳援；參謀長格奈森瑙則力主集中兵力先救威靈頓，並把軍隊的部署直接壓向法軍側後。內伊以步兵軍為核心，率約一萬五千騎兵反覆衝擊英軍中央，英軍近衛騎團與皇家蘇格蘭騷騎兵的回擊把法軍騎兵逐退。德埃隆元帥指揮第一軍在午後發動第一次正面進攻；杜魯特的第一軍、莫爾捷與蒂爾皮尼耶的近衛步兵與胸甲騎兵退守拉貝利昂，維克托在威靈頓右翼擋住格拉沃。英方有騎兵軍長烏克斯布里奇與戰歿的彭松比、十六日在四布拉日陣亡的皮克頓；普方有畢洛、齊滕、蒂爾曼等人。克勞塞維茨以普軍軍需官身分隨軍參戰，留下了關於此役的細節記述。西班牙方面，埃斯波茲·米納、安古萊姆公爵、埃布萊與莫林斯各領一軍，卻都沒有趕上滑鐵盧主戰場。
peopleEn: Napoleon Bonaparte was the hinge of the whole campaign: as emperor and commander-in-chief of the Army of the North he was wounded at La Belle Alliance on the eighteenth by a grapeshot, took a bullet in the leg, and still received his guard on horseback, asking whether the noise they heard was a rout or an advance. The Duke of Wellington, aged fifty-two, commanded the Anglo-Allied army on the ridge and absorbed the frontal effort of d'Erlon and the repeated charges of Ney's more than ten thousand horsemen. Blücher, already past seventy, was stationed at Wavre; at the sound of the guns from Waterloo he sent Bülow's fourth corps forward through the rain, while his chief of staff Gneisenau pressed for concentration and the concentration of everything on Napoleon's flank. Ney fought with the infantry at the core and some fifteen thousand cavalry, hammering the centre of the British line, until the Household Cavalry and the Royal Scots Greys rode back and drove the French horse away. Marshal d'Erlon ordered the first corps into the first frontal attack of the afternoon; Durutte's corps, Mortier and Tirpignier's Imperial Guard infantry and cuirassiers fell back on La Belle Alliance, while Victor held Wellington's right against Gravois. On the British side there was Lord Uxbridge commanding the cavalry, Ponsonby killed in action, and Picton, who fell at Quatre Bras two days earlier; on the Prussian side Bülow, Zieten and Thielmann. Clausewitz accompanied the Prussian army as its intendant and left behind one of the closest accounts of the battle. On the Spanish side Espoz y Mina, the Duke of Angoulême, Éblé and Salvador es Molins each led a corps, but none of them reached the Waterloo battlefield in time.
kits: 卡面這件輪發手槍是十五世紀末、十六世紀初出現的後膛手槍，機件由火藥盤、擊錘、鐵製簧輪與發條筒組成，擊發時以火石打擊火鐒引燃盤內火藥，發條筒須用專屬的鑰匙上弦，故每支手槍必配一支鑰匙。它的優點是不必像火繩槍那樣懸掛明火，能在風雨中保持待發，射程與精度都勝過火繩手槍；代價是機件繁複、造價高昂、重量偏大、裝填與復位緩慢，火藥盤一受潮即難以擊發。因此在十六世紀，它是西班牙大方陣中火槍隊軍官、旗手與王室近衛的標準佩槍，也是最早能連續擊發的後膛手槍，在歐洲自約一五〇〇年到十七世紀中葉長期是步軍軍官的制式裝備。滑鐵盧的戰場上，這件兵器早已退場：歐洲各國自十七世紀中葉起改用燧發手槍，一八一五年的法軍軍官佩一七七三年式燧發手槍，騎兵軍官佩帶刺刀的燧發手槍，英國軍官用燧發手槍配軍刀，普軍軍官用德式騎兵手槍；輪發手槍在西班牙只剩兩種身分，一是馬德里皇家兵工廠的陳列與王室的傳世器物，二是禁衛重整後沿用的儀仗舊例，實際作戰早已不可能。同一場戰役中真正決定勝負的是火槍與炮兵：英軍用一七九五年式短刺刀燧發滑膛步槍，配六磅與九磅銅炮；法軍用一七七七年式球形彈步槍，配六磅、十二磅野戰炮與四磅、六磅騎兵炮；普軍用一八〇六年式步槍配六磅步兵炮；兩軍在十九時以八十至一百門砲組成大炮連齊射，砲彈碎片與騷動同時傳到帝國大營。步槍連刺刀的重量約四公斤，一八一五年槍枝與刺刀的規格已標準化到可以大量補充；滑鐵盧戰場上被繳獲的法軍火砲後來由克魯伯家族買下，成為那家炮廠起家的資本。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the wheel-lock pistol, a rear-loading handgun that appeared in the late fifteenth and early sixteenth century. Its mechanism consists of a powder pan, a cock, a steel pyrite wheel and a spring barrel: on firing, the wheel strikes the frizzen and lights the charge in the pan, and the mainspring has to be wound with a dedicated key, so every pistol came with its own key. Its advantages over the matchlock are obvious, for no burning match had to be carried and the piece stayed ready in wind and rain, with better range and accuracy; its costs were a complicated, expensive mechanism, considerable weight, slow loading and resetting, and a powder pan that failed the moment it took damp. In the sixteenth century it was therefore the standard sidearm of officers, ensigns and the royal guards of the Spanish tercio, and it was the first handgun capable of repeated shots from the breech, remaining standard officer's equipment across Europe from about 1500 until the middle of the seventeenth century. On the Waterloo field the weapon had long since retired: European armies had adopted flintlock pistols from the mid-seventeenth century, and in 1815 French officers carried the 1773 flintlock pistol, mounted officers a flintlock with a bayonet, British officers flintlocks with their swords, and Prussian officers the German cavalry pistol. In Spain the wheel-lock survived in only two guises, as an object in the Royal Armoury of Madrid and as a dynastic keepsake kept in the guard's ceremonial tradition; in the field it was long impossible. What actually decided the battle was musketry and artillery. The British used the 1795 pattern flintlock musket with a short socket bayonet and their 6-pounder and 9-pounder brass guns; the French used the 1777 ball-breech musket with 6-, 12- and 4/6-pounder field and horse guns; the Prussians used the 1806 pattern musket with 6-pounder infantry pieces. At seven in the evening both sides massed eighty to a hundred guns into a grand battery and fired in salvo, and the same shot that shook the Imperial camp tore open the French right. A musket with bayonet weighed about four kilos, and by 1815 the standardisation of musket and bayonet was complete enough that losses of weapons could be made good in bulk; the French guns captured on the Waterloo field were later bought by the Krupp family and became the founding capital of their foundry.
tactics: 拿破崙的原計畫是以格拉沃與格魯希在沙勒羅瓦一線壓住普軍，主力自北繞打威靈頓的右翼與安特衛普的交通線；但十六日的里尼與四布拉日兩場側翼戰役各打各的，迂回未成，只剩正面強攻一途。十八日午前，法軍在拉艾聖田與赫加蒙兩處堡壘同英軍開火；午後一點半德埃隆第一軍自北面進攻威靈頓的中央陣地，兩點起內伊的騎兵在雨後泥濘中反覆衝鋒，英軍以近衛騎團與蘇格蘭騷騎兵的回衝把法騎逐退，威靈頓再調英軍旅與德意志外籍旅補上中央。到十九時，普軍畢洛第四軍自東面出現，與齊滕的騎兵旅同時衝擊法軍右翼，同時盟軍八十至一百門砲的大炮連齊射，砲火、喊聲與泥濘一同傳到帝國大營，於是近衛軍開始鬆動。威靈頓的部署是典型的反向斜坡防禦：英軍沿滑鐵盧山脊掘壕，士兵伏在坡後，讓法軍先開火而自己先還擊；中央是九十二高地團列陣，兩翼分置拉艾聖田與赫加蒙，拉艾聖田由黑衛士營與第四十四步兵營死守，赫加蒙由來福槍旅與四十二高地營抵抗，預備隊六千人待命。普軍的戰法是集中與側擊：布盧歇爾在瓦弗雷以蒂爾曼與齊滕拖住格魯希，畢洛冒雨行軍約二十公里，趕在關鍵時刻從法軍右後方切入。夜間法軍撤退，聯軍攻入拉貝利昂。命令傳遞全靠傳令官與旗語，拿破崙兩次要格魯希轉向馳援，格魯希都按字面執行，留在瓦弗雷與普軍糾纏，成為此役最受詬病的失誤。
tacticsEn: Napoleon's original plan was for Gravois and Grouchy to pin the Prussians along the Charleroi road while the main body wheeled north around Wellington's right and struck the Antwerp supply route; but the separate side battles of Ligny and Quatre Bras on the sixteenth were fought in isolation, the turning movement never came off, and a frontal attack was all that remained. On the morning of the eighteenth the French opened fire on the British at La Haye Sainte and Hougoumont; at half past one d'Erlon's first corps attacked Wellington's centre from the north, and from two o'clock Ney's cavalry charged again and again through the mud left by the rain, only to be driven back by the Household Cavalry and the Scots Greys, while Wellington fed fresh troops into the centre from an English brigade and the German foreign legions. At seven the Prussian fourth corps under Bülow appeared from the east and attacked the French right in concert with Zieten's cavalry brigade, while the allied grand battery of eighty to a hundred guns fired in salvo; the gunfire, the shouting and the mud all reached the Imperial camp at once and the guard began to shake. Wellington's deployment was a textbook reverse-slope defence: the British dug in along the Waterloo ridge and lay back behind the crest so that the French fired first and answered second. The Ninety-Second Highlanders stood in the centre, the two wings were anchored on La Haye Sainte and Hougoumont, the former held by the Black Watch and the 44th Foot and the latter by the Rifle Brigade and the 42nd Highlanders, with six thousand men in reserve. The Prussian method was concentration and flank: Blücher held Grouchy at Wavre with Thielmann and Zieten, and Bülow marched some twenty kilometres through the rain to arrive at the decisive moment on the French rear. The French retreated after dark and the allies entered La Belle Alliance. Orders moved only by mounted messenger and signal, and when Napoleon twice ordered Grouchy to turn and come to his support, Grouchy obeyed the letter of the order and stayed tangled with the Prussians at Wavre, the most blamed failure of the campaign.
data: 兵力：法軍在北方集團軍名下於比利時境內集結約十二萬五千人，可戰之兵約八萬；盟軍總動員約六十至七十萬，其中普軍約十萬（布盧歇爾麾下約五萬進入比利時）、奧軍約十萬、俄軍約三萬七千。滑鐵盧一戰，法軍出動約四萬九千至五萬三千人，盟軍約六萬八千至七萬五千人（威靈頓部約二萬三至二萬五千，布盧歇爾部約五萬，實際投入戰鬥者約二萬至二萬五千）。傷亡：法軍陣亡約四千至五千人、受傷約八千、被俘約八千至一萬，合計約二萬二千至二萬八千；盟軍約二萬二千人，其中威靈頓部死傷約四千二百人，普軍約一萬五千人且多為傷兵；法軍損失馬匹四千至五千匹。十六日的四布拉日，法軍約二萬三千人對聯軍約七千至八千人，法軍損失約四千至五千，聯軍約一千五百人；里尼一役法軍約二萬對普軍約二萬二千，雙方各有數千人傷亡。距離與時間：畢洛第四軍自瓦弗雷行軍約十五公里，齊滕的騎兵在十九時三十分前後投入戰鬥，普軍騎兵衝鋒規模約二千至三千騎，大炮連齊射約六十分鐘。彈藥：英軍步兵每人攜六十發，法軍九十至一百二十發；每門野戰砲每日備彈二百發，補充用彈藥車每車六十發，缺彈時陣地火力即難以維持。以上數字多源於戰後各軍戰報與近世史家的估算，具體數目諸說並存，只宜作量級參考。
dataEn: Manpower: the French concentrated about 125,000 men in the Army of the North inside Belgium, of whom some eighty thousand were fit for service; the allies mobilised on the order of six to seven hundred thousand in total, of whom about 100,000 were Prussian (roughly 50,000 under Blücher entering Belgium), 100,000 Austrian and 37,000 Russian. At Waterloo the French deployed some 49,000 to 53,000 men against 68,000 to 75,000 allies, Wellington holding 23,000 to 25,000 and Blücher 50,000, of whom perhaps 20,000 to 25,000 actually fought. Casualties: the French lost about 4,000 to 5,000 dead, some 8,000 wounded and 8,000 to 10,000 prisoners, roughly 22,000 to 28,000 in all; the allies lost about 22,000, of whom 4,200 fell with Wellington and some 15,000 with the Prussians, mostly wounded; the French also lost 4,000 to 5,000 horses. At Quatre Bras on the sixteenth, some 23,000 French faced 7,000 to 8,000 of the allies and lost 4,000 to 5,000 against 1,500 of the enemy; at Ligny 20,000 French met 22,000 Prussians with several thousand casualties on each side. Distance and time: Bülow's fourth corps marched some fifteen kilometres from Wavre, Zieten's cavalry came into contact around half past seven in the evening, the Prussian mounted charge numbered perhaps 2,000 to 3,000 riders, and the grand battery fired for about an hour. Ammunition: British infantry carried sixty rounds a man, the French ninety to 120; each field gun had 200 rounds a day, replenished from caissons holding sixty rounds, and without resupply a position's fire could not be maintained. These figures come from regimental returns and later modern estimates; the exact numbers are disputed and should be read as orders of magnitude rather than as facts.
cause: 這場戰爭的根子是維也納體系對法國的處置失衡。一八一四年拿破崙第一次退位，被流放厄爾巴島，保留皇帝名號；四國聯軍既不願他重回巴黎，又不敢立即廢黜，維也納會議因此把他遷往遠方，這種半囚半王的安排本身就埋下隱患。他在西歐的流亡生涯僅維持約十個月，隨即於一八一五年三月一日離開厄爾巴，十三日登陸法國，十七日進入巴黎，二十日路易十八出逃里爾，波旁王朝在法國人心中的合法性被這場復辟一擊而破。導火索是三月七日維也納的宣言，把拿破崙宣布為普魯士與奧地利的敵人；三月十八日他率軍越過西霍埃邊界進軍比利時，等於主動對歐洲列強開戰，聯軍隨即依條約視之為共同敵人。聯盟之所以能迅速成形，還因為一八一二至一八一四年的第六次同盟已把法國陸軍打殘，歐洲列強相信只有徹底解除法國武裝才能讓維也納體系長久，而拿破崙本人也明白，一旦比利時的三角洲被法軍控制，他與巴黎之間的交通線就暴露在敵軍打擊之下。西班牙、法國南部的波旁分子與比利時的愛國者提供了抵抗的土壤，令法軍必須分兵，於是整個歐洲在十九天內重新站成一邊。
causeEn: The root of the war lay in the imbalance of the Vienna settlement towards France. In 1814 Napoleon abdicated for the first time and was exiled to Elba while keeping the imperial title; the four powers neither wanted him back in Paris nor dared depose him outright, so the Congress of Vienna shipped him further away, and that half-prison, half-crown arrangement buried the fault line. His exile in western Europe lasted barely ten months: on 1 March 1815 he left Elba, landed in France on the thirteenth, entered Paris on the seventeenth, and on the twentieth Louis XVIII fled to Lille, so that the legitimacy of the Bourbons in French eyes was shattered in a single blow. The immediate spark was the declaration of Vienna on 7 March naming Napoleon an enemy of Prussia and Austria; on 18 March he crossed the frontier of the Sambre and marched into Belgium, which was in itself an act of war against the powers of Europe, and the allies at once treated him as a common enemy under the terms of their alliance. The coalition could form so quickly because the Sixth Coalition of 1812 to 1814 had already broken the French army, and the powers had come to believe that only the complete disarmament of France would make the Vienna settlement durable. Napoleon knew the same logic from the other side: once the Belgian triangle was in French hands, his line of communication with Paris lay open to enemy attack. Spain, the Bourbons of southern France and the Belgian patriots gave the resistance a soil to grow in, forcing the French to divide their forces, and within nineteen days the whole of Europe had closed ranks again.
impact: 滑鐵盧之後，歐洲的權力結構被重新固定下來：一八一五年九月十四日的神聖同盟、同月二十日的四國同盟條約，以及一八二〇年聯邦干預西班牙的決議，接連把維也納的疆界與君主制原則維持了半個多世紀；法國被排除在歐洲協調之外，到一八一八年才重返。第二次巴黎和約在一八一五年十一月二十日簽訂，法國失去薩克森與萊茵的緩衝、支付巨額賠款並被聯軍佔領至一八一八年。拿破崙被送上英國戰艦後轉往聖赫勒拿，一八一五年十月十五日抵達，一八二一年五月五日死在那裡，帝國的象徵從此只存於傳說與回憶。軍事技術上，一八一五年是燧發槍炮標準化的最後一步，刺刀、炮架、彈藥車與野戰醫療在這場戰役後趨於定型，被視為通往鐵路與總動員時代的前夜。西班牙在此役中保住王位費爾南多七世，軍隊因戰績獲得榮譽，隨後卻在一八一九至一八二三年間被用來鎮壓自由派，並投入南美獨立的干預；荷蘭與比利時則合併為一八一五年的聯合王國，成為維也納體系北面的一枚棋子。長期看，滑鐵盧一詞在歐洲語言中成為決定性失敗的代名詞，德國克魯伯家族的炮廠正是靠收購這片戰場上繳獲的法軍火砲起家，最終成為德國工業的象徵。
impactEn: After Waterloo the structure of European power was fixed afresh. The Holy Alliance of 14 September 1815, the Quadruple Alliance of 20 November, and the allied resolution of intervention in Spain in 1820 held the Vienna borders and the principle of monarchy in place for half a century; France was locked out of the European concert and did not return to it until 1818. The Second Treaty of Paris was signed on 20 November 1815, by which France lost Saxony and the buffer of the Rhineland, undertook a large indemnity, and remained occupied by allied troops until 1818. Napoleon was put aboard a British warship and carried to Saint Helena, arriving on 15 October 1815 and dying there on 5 May 1821; from then on the empire survived only in legend and memory. In military terms 1815 was the last step in the standardisation of flintlock muskets and guns, and bayonets, gun carriages, caissons and field medical services settled into a fixed pattern after the battle, being read as the eve of the railway and of the era of general mobilisation. Spain kept the throne of Ferdinand VII and the army came away with a reputation for valour, only to be used from 1819 to 1823 to crush the liberals and then to intervene in the wars of South American independence; Holland and Belgium were combined into the United Kingdom of the Netherlands, a piece on the northern side of the Vienna settlement. In the long run the name Waterloo became in European speech the synonym for a decisive defeat, and the Krupp foundry in Germany began precisely by buying the French guns captured on that battlefield, ending as a symbol of German industry.
result: 法軍在六月十八日傍晚全面崩潰，棄置八十門砲與全部輜重，連夜退回法國邊境；十九日格魯希在瓦弗雷擊退蒂爾曼，卻始終未能扭轉戰局。拿破崙回到巴黎後在六月廿二日再度退位，百日王朝結束，北方集團軍隨之解散，軍官與士兵大量被遣散回鄉。內伊被召回巴黎並解除元帥職務，兩年後在政變中遭槍決；格魯希失去元帥榮譽，此生再未復出，直到一八九二年羅斯唐的劇本《雄鷹》把他寫成悲劇人物，格魯希條款才重新出現在歐洲的文學想像之中。普軍在三月三十一日率聯軍進入巴黎，佔領首都近一年後退出；威靈頓獲封威靈頓侯爵與公爵，一八二八年出任英國首相。戰役的最終政治結果之一，是一八二一年三月六日英國批准拿破崙的繼承人奧古斯特·波拿巴為奧爾良公爵，拿破崙二世於一八三二年去世後，他仍保有該頭銜並於一八五二年以拿破崙三世之名登上法國皇位，說明維也納體系對波旁正統的認定並非不可動搖。滑鐵盧之後近四十年，歐洲再無同等規模的大戰，局勢維持到克里米亞戰爭為止，這段被稱為歐洲均勢的時代，其起點正是這場戰役。
resultEn: The French army collapsed completely in the evening of 18 June, abandoning some eighty guns and all its baggage and withdrawing to the frontier through the night; on the nineteenth Grouchy beat Thielmann at Wavre but could not turn the campaign. Napoleon was back in Paris and abdicated for the second time on 22 June, the Hundred Days ended, the Army of the North was dissolved and its officers and men scattered to their homes. Ney was recalled to Paris and stripped of his marshal's staff, and was shot in a coup two years later; Grouchy lost his command and never returned to public life until Edmond Rostand's play L'Aiglon in 1892 turned him into a tragic figure and the clause of Grouchy entered the European literary imagination. The Prussians entered Paris with the allies on 31 March and withdrew after an occupation of nearly a year, while Wellington was raised to the viscountcy and dukedom of Wellington and became British prime minister in 1828. One of the final political results of the campaign came on 6 March 1821, when Britain recognised Napoleon's heir, Auguste Bonaparte, as Duke of Orléans: after the death of Napoleon II in 1832 the title was still held, and in 1852 its bearer took the French throne as Napoleon III, showing that the Vienna settlement's verdict on Bourbon legitimacy was never unbreakable. For nearly forty years after Waterloo Europe saw no war on that scale, and the balance held until the Crimean War; the age now called the European concert had its beginning in this battle.
